description: Run IP geolocation for up to 200 IP addresses in a single call. Emulated bulk: the server fans out single lookups concurrently, 1 credit per input. Use this whenever you have ≥2 IPs to enrich. For >200 IPs, split client-side; WhoisXML's Bulk IP Geolocation API (not a tool on this server) runs asynchronous JSON jobs of up to 100,000 IPs. Do NOT use this for ASN/CIDR ownership lookups (use `ip_netblocks`) or for a single IP (use `ipgeolocation` directly).

confirm.description: Pass true to run a call estimated at over 100 credits, once the user has agreed to that cost.

ip_addresses.description: IP addresses to look up (1 credit per IP, max 200 per call).

name: bulk_ip_geolocation
